messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, Jun 2, 2027 at 10:12 AM PDT
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth / follow-up

Alex - thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, we'd like to kick off the vendor security questionnaire so your security/compliance team can move through our SIG/CAIQ and get the SOC 2/BAA questions validated. Attached is our SIG initiation form to capture contacts and scope.

Quick recap / asks:
- Scope: you mentioned AcmeHealth would want Redwood to process patient engagement data (patient notes & appointment metadata). Please confirm whether that includes PHI that falls under HIPAA.
- SOC 2: can you confirm which SOC 2 report you need us to provide (Type II) and the latest report date that would be acceptable?
- BAA: please confirm if Acme requires a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) in addition to the standard contract.
- Questionnaire format: do you prefer the full SIG (SIG Lite/Standard) or CAIQ? We typically do SIG + supporting evidence.
- Timeline: what internal timeline does Acme have for completing the questionnaire?

Next steps I propose:
1) Please complete the attached SIG-Initiation-Form.pdf with the security contact, procurement contact, and preferred questionnaire format.
2) Once we have that, I'll assign Marissa (security lead) and Neha (privacy lead) to coordinate evidence collection and timelines.
3) If a BAA is required, we'll route a BAA template for signature via DocuSign.

I attached the initiation form to this thread. If any of the scope above is incorrect, call it out and we'll update. Looking to align on preferred questionnaire (SIG vs CAIQ) and BAA requirement.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0124

Thanks Dylan - appreciate the summary. Answers inline below.

On Wed, Jun 2, 2027 at 10:12 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex - thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, we'd like to kick off the vendor security questionnaire so your security/compliance team can move through our SIG/CAIQ and get the SOC 2/BAA questions validated. Attached is our SIG initiation form to capture contacts and scope.

Scope: Confirmed - we will be sending patient engagement data that includes PHI (patient names, appointment notes, limited demographics).

SOC 2: We need SOC 2 Type II. The report should be within the last 12 months - anything older won't be acceptable.

BAA: Yes - AcmeHealth requires a BAA. Please route your standard BAA; procurement will need to review.

Questionnaire format: Our security team prefers SIG Standard + CAIQ as a supplement. If you can start with the full SIG that would be ideal.

Timeline: We aim to complete vendor security reviews within 4 weeks from initiation, but procurement may push depending on workload - happy to start sooner.

A couple of clarifying questions from our security team:
1) Do you support customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK/KMS) for data at rest?
2) For SOC 2 evidence, can you provide a summary mapping of controls to evidence artifacts (e.g., policies, screenshots) rather than full raw logs?
3) Where will the production data be hosted (region)? We need confirmation that data residency will be US-only for this workload.

I attached a procurement contact form (Acme_Procurement-Contact.v1.pdf) with the right people - procurement@acmehealth.com is the main contact. Looping them here.

--Alex

Alex - perfect, thanks for the fast turnaround and for confirming scope. Answers below and next steps.

On your security questions:
1) Customer-managed keys: we support customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS providers on our Private and Dedicated deployments. For hosted API customers we offer bring-your-own-key (BYOK) options for enterprise plans; we'll confirm specific KMS providers in the paperwork.
2) SOC 2 evidence: yes - we provide a control-to-evidence mapping (policy docs, screenshots, change logs) and can annotate where raw logs are available; we only provide raw logs under scoped audit requests or under a specific contract clause.
3) Data residency: for this workload we can guarantee US-only hosting (US regions) and will document the region in the BAA/contract.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I'll attach the full SIG once you confirm the initiation form. Marissa (cc'd) will own questionnaire responses and evidence collection. Neha will scope the BAA and privacy responses.
- We'll target a 3-week turnaround on the SIG unless procurement requests additional review time. If Acme needs the full 4 weeks, let us know and we'll adjust.
- I'll open a HubSpot deal note (ACME-2319) and share the docs at: https://redwood-inference.sharepoint.com/sites/security/SIG-ACME-2319

Action items:
- Alex / procurement: please return the filled SIG-Initiation-Form.pdf and confirm preferred KMS vendor (if BYOK required).
- Redwood (Dylan/Marissa): prepare SIG and control-evidence mapping; prepare BAA draft for procurement review.

If that looks good I'll kick this off internally today.

Thanks - talk soon.
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
